Security & Privacy Event Register
=================================

### SEC-00000001-0037
Security event SEC-00000001-0037 was opened by Diya Joshi in Vadodara after a report involving configuration mismatch. Affected function: Facilities. Priority: P2. State: pending.
The responder evaluated whether the event involved credentials, confidential data, endpoint compromise, privileged access, or a normal business operation. Business urgency was considered but did not authorize an undocumented bypass.
Evidence was collected using approved systems, and secrets were excluded from the incident narrative. Any temporary privileged access would require a defined purpose and review after the urgent work was complete. Retention obligations may continue after the incident is resolved.
